bio.text: Bryan Townsend represents the 11th District in the Delaware Senate, covering southern Newark and parts of Bear and Glasgow; he was first elected in 2012.
The Senate Democratic Caucus elected him Majority Whip in 2018, and he has been Majority Leader since 2020.
He graduated from Glasgow High School in 1999, attended the University of Delaware and the University of Cambridge, and received a law degree from Yale Law School in 2009.
After law school he clerked for Chancellor William Chandler III of the Delaware Court of Chancery and then practiced as an attorney focused on corporate litigation.
